import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="0fa1a0608a98fb975f2c7387635c049578b613bb"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

ci=wt/".github/workflows/ci.yml"
text=ci.read_text()
old='''      - run: do-again doctor
      - run: do-again status
'''
new='''      # Fresh CI runners intentionally have no installed per-project service/runtime.
      # Smoke the CLI surface here; fixture tests assert health exit codes separately.
      - run: do-again doctor --help
      - run: do-again status --help
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("CI doctor/status smoke anchor missing")
ci.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1))

tp=wt/"tests/test_cli.py"
tt=tp.read_text()
marker='''    def test_doctor_fix_creates_safe_runtime_dirs_without_service_restart(self) -> None:
'''
insert='''    def test_doctor_returns_nonzero_for_missing_local_runtime(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            repo = self.make_repo(Path(tmp))
            layout = runtime_layout(repo)
            output = io.StringIO()
            with (
                patch("do_again.cli.runtime_layout", return_value=layout),
                patch("do_again.cli.service_status", return_value={"installed": False, "running": False}),
                redirect_stdout(output),
            ):
                rc = doctor(str(repo), fix=False)
            self.assertEqual(rc, 1)
            self.assertIn("service_installed", output.getvalue())
            self.assertIn("control_worktree", output.getvalue())

'''
if marker not in tt:
    raise SystemExit("doctor test insertion anchor missing")
if "test_doctor_returns_nonzero_for_missing_local_runtime" not in tt:
    tt=tt.replace(marker,insert+marker,1)
tp.write_text(tt)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")

compile_proc=run(["python3","-m","py_compile","tests/test_cli.py"],check=False,env=env)
print("compile_rc="+str(compile_proc.returncode))
print(compile_proc.stderr)
if compile_proc.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(compile_proc.returncode)

focused=run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

# Smoke the exact CI commands against the source tree.
for args in [
    ["python3","-m","do_again.cli","doctor","--help"],
    ["python3","-m","do_again.cli","status","--help"],
]:
    proc=run(args,check=False,env=env)
    print("cmd=",args,"rc=",proc.returncode)
    if proc.returncode:
        print(proc.stdout); print(proc.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)

run(["git","add",".github/workflows/ci.yml","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Fix clean-runner doctor CI contract"],check=False)
print(commit.stdout)
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
